تكتسبوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِبُوا (taktasibū) /tak.ta.si.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# تُكْتَسَبُوا (tuktasabū) /tuk.ta.sa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
